name: Jesus
did: Born of Mary, taught and healed, died for our sins (John 3:16), rose again (Matthew 28), ascended; coming again
impact: Salvation for all who believe; the way, the truth, and the life

name: Mary Magdalene
who: Woman from Magdala, devoted follower of Jesus
did: Jesus cast 7 demons out of her (Luke 8:2). Funded ministry, stood at cross (John 19:25), first to see risen Jesus (John 20:11-18)
impact: First witness to resurrection; key female disciple

name: Moses
who: Hebrew prophet, lawgiver, leader of Israel out of Egypt
did: Led Israelites through Red Sea (Exodus 14), received Ten Commandments (Exodus 20), interceded for the people (Numbers 14)
impact: Delivered God's law; typified Christ as prophet and mediator

name: David
who: Shepherd boy, king of Israel, man after God's own heart
did: Defeated Goliath (1 Samuel 17), established Jerusalem, wrote many Psalms, covenant with God (2 Samuel 7)
impact: Ancestor of Christ; model of worship, repentance, and trust

name: Abraham
who: Father of faith, called out of Ur
did: Left homeland by faith (Genesis 12), covenant: descendants as stars (Genesis 15), offered Isaac; God provided ram (Genesis 22)
impact: Father of nations; faith credited as righteousness

name: Paul
who: Persecutor turned apostle, missionary to the Gentiles
did: Converted on Damascus road (Acts 9), missionary journeys, wrote much of the NT (Romans, Corinthians, Ephesians, etc.), finished the race (2 Timothy 4:7)
impact: Spread gospel to Gentiles; shaped Christian doctrine

name: Peter
who: Fisherman, one of the twelve, leader of the early church
did: Confessed Christ as Messiah (Matthew 16:16), denied Jesus, restored (John 21), preached at Pentecost (Acts 2), healed in Jesus' name
impact: Rock of the church; bold witness to Jews and Gentiles

name: Esther
did: Risked her life to save her people (Esther 4-5), 'For such a time as this', Haman's plot overturned
impact: Deliverance of Jews in exile; model of courage

name: Daniel
who: Exile in Babylon, prophet, advisor to kings
did: Refused king's meat (Daniel 1), lions' den (Daniel 6), interpreted dreams, visions of the Son of man
impact: Faithful under pressure; foreshadowed Christ's kingdom

name: Noah
who: Righteous man, builder of the ark
did: Built ark by faith (Genesis 6), saved household from flood, covenant with God: rainbow (Genesis 9)
impact: Preserved humanity; model of obedience when the world says otherwise

name: Sarah
who: Wife of Abraham, mother of nations
did: Left Ur with Abraham, laughed at the promise, bore Isaac in old age (Genesis 21)
impact: By faith received strength; mother of the promised line

name: Joseph
who: Son of Jacob, sold into Egypt
did: Rose from slave to ruler (Genesis 41), interpreted Pharaoh's dreams, saved his family; 'God meant it for good' (Genesis 50:20)
impact: God's sovereignty in suffering; reconciliation and provision

name: Ruth
did: 'Thy people shall be my people' (Ruth 1:16), gleaned in Boaz's field, great-grandmother of David
impact: Loyalty and redemption; in the lineage of Christ

name: Elijah
who: Prophet of Israel, fed by ravens
did: Fire on Carmel: God vs Baal (1 Kings 18), raised widow's son, taken up in chariot of fire (2 Kings 2)
impact: Stood for God alone; typified John the Baptist

name: Mary
did: 'Be it unto me according to thy word' (Luke 1:38), bore Christ, Magnificat, stood at the cross
impact: Model of surrender; blessed among women

name: John the Baptist
who: Voice in the wilderness, forerunner of Christ
did: Prepared the way, baptized Jesus in the Jordan (Matthew 3), beheaded by Herod
impact: Greatest among those born of women; pointed to the Lamb

name: Joshua
who: Successor to Moses, leader into Canaan
did: Walls of Jericho fell (Joshua 6), 'As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord' (Joshua 24:15)
impact: Courage and obedience; led Israel into the promised land

name: Job
did: Lost all; held fast; 'The LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away' (Job 1:21); restored twofold
impact: Faith in suffering; God's sovereignty over evil

name: Rahab
who: Harlot of Jericho who hid the spies
did: Scarlet cord; household saved (Joshua 2), in the lineage of Christ (Matthew 1:5)
impact: Faith in action; God uses the unlikely

name: Solomon
who: Son of David, king of Israel
did: Asked for wisdom; God gave it (1 Kings 3), built the temple, wrote Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Song of Solomon
impact: Wisdom and worship; Israel's golden age

name: Stephen
did: Full of faith and the Holy Spirit (Acts 6), saw heaven open, stoned while forgiving (Acts 7)
impact: Bold witness; death sparked wider spread of the gospel

name: Timothy
who: Young disciple, Paul's son in the faith
did: Co-labored with Paul, received pastoral letters (1–2 Timothy), led the church at Ephesus
impact: Faithful next generation; model of godly leadership

name: Adam
who: First man, created in God's image
did: Named the animals, fell in Eden; God promised a Redeemer (Genesis 3:15)
impact: Head of humanity; fall brought need for salvation

name: Eve
did: Tempted in Eden, shared the fall, mother of all living (Genesis 3:20)
impact: Mother of humanity; promise of offspring who would crush the serpent

name: Isaac
who: Son of promise, born to Sarah
did: Carried wood for the altar (Genesis 22), blessed Jacob and Esau, dug wells of living water
impact: Type of Christ offered up; covenant passed to Jacob

name: Jacob
who: Son of Isaac, father of the twelve tribes
did: Wrestled with God; name changed to Israel (Genesis 32:28), twelve sons, blessed by Isaac
impact: Nation of Israel; clung to God and prevailed

name: Aaron
who: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel
did: Spokesman for Moses (Exodus 4), rod budded; priesthood confirmed (Numbers 17)
impact: Leviticus priesthood; foreshadowed Christ as high priest

name: Samson
who: Nazirite judge, strength in his hair
did: Judged Israel twenty years, fell to Delilah, died destroying the Philistines (Judges 16:28)
impact: Warning against compromise; God used flawed vessel

name: Elisha
who: Successor to Elijah, prophet of Israel
did: Asked for double portion (2 Kings 2:9), healed Naaman, raised the dead, saw Elijah taken up
impact: Miracles and prophecy; continued Elijah's ministry

name: Jonah
did: Swallowed by fish (Jonah 2), preached to Nineveh; city repented, learned of God's mercy
impact: God's mercy to Gentiles; obedience despite reluctance

name: Lazarus
who: Brother of Mary and Martha, friend of Jesus
did: Raised from the dead by Jesus (John 11:43), 'Loose him, and let him go'
impact: Jesus is the resurrection; foreshadowed our own rising

name: Deborah
did: Led Israel to victory over Sisera (Judges 4-5), Barak would not go without her
impact: Female leadership; God's deliverance through the willing

name: Gideon
did: Fleece signs (Judges 6), 300 against Midian (Judges 7), 'The sword of the LORD and of Gideon'
impact: God's strength in weakness; faith over numbers

name: Samuel
who: Prophet and judge, last of the judges
did: Called as a boy (1 Samuel 3), anointed Saul and David, 'Speak, for thy servant heareth'
impact: Transition to monarchy; faithful intercessor

name: Nehemiah
who: Cupbearer to the king, rebuilder of Jerusalem
did: Led rebuilding of the walls (Nehemiah 2-6), faced opposition, restored worship
impact: Leadership in adversity; prayer and action

name: Isaiah
who: Major prophet, saw the Lord high and lifted up
did: Vision of God's throne (Isaiah 6), prophesied Messiah (Isaiah 53), 'Here am I; send me'
impact: Messianic prophecies; holiness and hope

name: Jeremiah
did: Prophesied fall of Jerusalem, lamentations, 'I know the plans I have for you' (Jeremiah 29:11)
impact: Faithfulness in rejection; God's enduring covenant

name: Martha
who: Sister of Mary and Lazarus, friend of Jesus
did: Served; 'Lord, if thou hadst been here' (John 11:21); Jesus: 'I am the resurrection'
impact: Service and grief; Jesus meets us in both

name: Barnabas
who: Son of encouragement, early church leader
did: Sold land for the church (Acts 4), vouched for Paul (Acts 9), missionary with Paul (Acts 13)
impact: Encouragement and partnership; raised up others

name: John
did: Leaned on Jesus at Last Supper, stood at the cross, received Mary, wrote John, Revelation
impact: Love and witness; closed the canon with Revelation

name: Enoch
who: Walked with God, seventh from Adam
did: Walked with God 300 years; God took him (Genesis 5:24), did not see death
impact: Faith that pleases God; type of the rapture

name: Caleb
who: Spy who believed, companion of Joshua
did: Brought back good report from Canaan (Numbers 13-14), received Hebron at 85 (Joshua 14)
impact: Wholehearted faith; God rewards those who follow fully

name: Ezra
who: Scribe and priest, restorer of the law
did: Led Israelites back from Babylon (Ezra 7), read and taught the law (Nehemiah 8), restored worship
impact: Revival through Scripture; model of devotion to God's Word

name: Ezekiel
who: Prophet in exile, saw visions of God
did: Vision of God's glory (Ezekiel 1), valley of dry bones (Ezekiel 37), temple vision
impact: Hope in exile; God's glory and restoration

name: Hannah
who: Mother of Samuel, woman of prayer
did: Prayed for a son; vowed him to the Lord (1 Samuel 1), sang a song of praise
impact: Faithful prayer; surrendered her child to God

name: Hezekiah
did: Cleaned the temple, restored Passover (2 Chronicles 30), prayed for deliverance; God added 15 years (2 Kings 20)
impact: Revival under a godly king; God hears prayer

name: James
who: Apostle, brother of John, son of Zebedee
did: One of the inner three (Peter, James, John), first apostle martyred (Acts 12:2)
impact: Bold witness; counted worthy to suffer for Christ

name: James
who: Brother of Jesus, leader of the Jerusalem church
did: Led Jerusalem council (Acts 15), wrote the epistle of James, 'Faith without works is dead'
impact: Practical faith; bridged Jewish and Gentile believers

name: Joseph of Arimathea
who: Rich disciple, member of the Sanhedrin
did: Asked for Jesus' body, laid Him in his own tomb (Matthew 27:57-60)
impact: Bold in death; honored Christ when others fled

name: Matthew
did: Left everything to follow Jesus (Matthew 9:9), wrote the Gospel of Matthew
impact: Grace to the outcast; God's kingdom for sinners

name: Nathan
did: Confronted David over Bathsheba (2 Samuel 12), 'Thou art the man'; announced Solomon's reign
impact: Courage to speak truth to power; God's messenger

name: Nicodemus
did: Came to Jesus by night (John 3), 'Born again'; helped bury Jesus (John 19:39)
impact: Seeking truth; faith that grows in secret

name: Philip
did: Brought Nathanael to Jesus (John 1:43), fed 5000 (John 6), baptized Ethiopian eunuch (Acts 8)
impact: Evangelist; 'Come and see'

name: Thomas
did: 'Unless I see... I will not believe' (John 20:25); 'My Lord and my God' (John 20:28)
impact: Honest doubt met by grace; confessed Christ

name: Elizabeth
who: Mother of John the Baptist, cousin of Mary
did: Conceived in old age (Luke 1), 'Blessed art thou among women'; greeted Mary
impact: God's promise fulfilled; supported Mary

name: Anna
did: Served God night and day (Luke 2:36-38), saw infant Jesus, gave thanks
impact: Faithful waiting; recognized the Messiah

name: Andrew
did: Brought Peter to Jesus (John 1:40-42), found boy with loaves and fish (John 6:8)
impact: Bring others to Jesus; simple faithfulness

name: Luke
did: Wrote Luke and Acts, traveled with Paul, documented the early church
impact: Careful history; gospel for all nations

name: Mark
who: John Mark, companion of Paul and Peter
did: Wrote the Gospel of Mark, likely source of Peter's testimony
impact: Action-oriented gospel; servant of the apostles

name: Silas
did: Sang in prison with Paul (Acts 16:25), co-wrote 1–2 Thessalonians
impact: Steadfast in suffering; partnership in ministry

name: Priscilla
did: Taught Apollos (Acts 18:26), hosted church with Aquila, risked life for Paul
impact: Women in ministry; teaching and hospitality

name: Aquila
did: Taught Apollos with Priscilla (Acts 18:26), hosted church, traveled with Paul
impact: Partnership in marriage and ministry

name: Lydia
who: Seller of purple, first European convert
did: Heart opened by the Lord (Acts 16:14), baptized with household, hosted Paul
impact: God opens hearts; hospitality to the gospel

name: Cornelius
did: Vision of angel (Acts 10), sent for Peter, received Holy Spirit; household baptized
impact: Gospel to Gentiles; God prepares the way

name: Bartholomew
did: Brought to Jesus by Philip (John 1:45-49), 'Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?'; 'Rabbi, thou art the Son of God'
impact: Honest skeptic who believed; one of the twelve

name: James the Less
did: One of the twelve (Matthew 10:3, Mark 3:18), sometimes identified with James the brother of the Lord
impact: Faithful among the twelve; lesser-known but chosen

name: Judas Thaddaeus
who: Apostle, also called Jude or Lebbaeus
did: One of the twelve (Luke 6:16), asked Jesus 'How is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us?' (John 14:22)
impact: Wrote the epistle of Jude; faithful to the end

name: Simon the Zealot
did: Listed among the twelve (Luke 6:15, Acts 1:13); former Zealot, now zealous for Christ
impact: Political radical transformed; zeal redirected to the kingdom

name: Judas Iscariot
did: Betrayed Jesus for thirty pieces of silver (Matthew 26:14-16), hanged himself (Matthew 27:5)
impact: Warning against greed and unbelief; chosen yet fell

name: Saul
did: Anointed by Samuel (1 Samuel 10), defeated Ammonites, disobeyed; rejected by God (1 Samuel 15)
impact: Israel's first king; warning against pride and disobedience

name: Bathsheba
who: Wife of David, mother of Solomon
did: Mother of Solomon (2 Samuel 12:24), advocated for his kingship (1 Kings 1), in lineage of Christ
impact: Grace after sin; mother of Israel's wisest king

name: Boaz
did: Redeemed Ruth (Ruth 4), married her, great-grandfather of David
impact: Type of Christ as redeemer; kindness to the foreigner

name: Naomi
did: Returned from Moab with Ruth (Ruth 1), 'Call me Mara'; guided Ruth to Boaz
impact: God restores; bitterness turned to blessing

name: Mordecai
did: Uncovered plot against king (Esther 2), urged Esther to act (Esther 4), honored by Xerxes
impact: Courage behind the throne; 'For such a time as this'

name: Josiah
did: Found the Book of the Law (2 Kings 22), tore clothes, led nationwide revival, killed at Megiddo
impact: Revival through Scripture; no king like him before or after

name: Zechariah
who: Priest, father of John the Baptist
did: Vision in temple (Luke 1:11-20), struck mute until John's birth, sang the Benedictus
impact: Faith in God's promise; prepared the way for his son

name: Malachi
who: Last prophet of the Old Testament
did: Prophesied coming of Elijah (Malachi 4:5), messenger to prepare the way
impact: Bridge to the NT; pointed to John the Baptist

name: Hosea
did: Lived out God's love for unfaithful Israel (Hosea 1-3), 'I will betroth thee unto me forever'
impact: God's relentless love; prophecy of restoration

name: Amos
did: Prophesied judgment on Israel (Amos 5), 'Let justice roll down like waters' (Amos 5:24)
impact: Justice and righteousness; God demands both

name: Mary of Bethany
did: Sat at Jesus' feet (Luke 10:39), anointed Jesus with perfume (John 12:3), 'Chosen the good part'
impact: Devotion and worship; Jesus defended her choice

name: Zacchaeus
did: Climbed sycamore tree (Luke 19:4), hosted Jesus, 'Salvation has come to this house'
impact: Jesus seeks the lost; repentance and restitution

name: Titus
did: Led church in Crete (Titus 1:5), received epistle from Paul, uncircumcised (Galatians 2:3)
impact: Gentile leadership; faithful delegate

name: Apollos
did: Taught accurately about Jesus (Acts 18:24-28), instructed by Priscilla and Aquila, ministered in Corinth
impact: Gifted teacher; teachable and bold

name: Dorcas
who: Disciple in Joppa, also called Tabitha
did: Full of good works (Acts 9:36), raised from the dead by Peter (Acts 9:40)
impact: Serving the needy; God's power over death

name: Rebekah
who: Wife of Isaac, mother of Jacob and Esau
did: Drew water for Abraham's servant (Genesis 24), helped Jacob receive the blessing (Genesis 27)
impact: Chosen for Isaac; mother of nations

name: Rachel
who: Wife of Jacob, mother of Joseph and Benjamin
did: Jacob served 14 years for her (Genesis 29), died in childbirth (Genesis 35:18)
impact: Beloved wife; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

name: Leah
who: First wife of Jacob, mother of six tribes
did: Bore Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah (Genesis 29), 'Now I will praise the LORD' (Genesis 29:35)
impact: Mother of Judah; lineage of Christ

name: Esau
who: Elder twin of Jacob, son of Isaac
did: Sold birthright for stew (Genesis 25:34), lost blessing; reconciled with Jacob (Genesis 33)
impact: Despised his birthright; warning against the short-term

name: Lot
did: Chose Sodom (Genesis 13), rescued by angels (Genesis 19), wife became pillar of salt
impact: Righteous man in wicked city; rescued but lost much

name: Miriam
who: Sister of Moses and Aaron, prophetess
did: Watched baby Moses (Exodus 2), led song after Red Sea (Exodus 15:21), struck with leprosy (Numbers 12)
impact: First prophetess; worship and warning

name: Jethro
who: Father-in-law of Moses, priest of Midian
did: Gave Moses Zipporah (Exodus 2), advised delegation of judges (Exodus 18)
impact: Wisdom and support; Moses' counselor

name: Zerubbabel
who: Governor of Judah, led return from exile
did: Led rebuilding of the temple (Ezra 3-5), 'Not by might, nor by power' (Zechariah 4:6)
impact: Restored worship; in lineage of Christ

name: Haggai
did: Urged rebuilding of the temple (Haggai 1), 'Consider your ways'
impact: Priorities; put God's house first

name: Micah
did: 'But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah' (Micah 5:2), 'What doth the LORD require?' (Micah 6:8)
impact: Messianic prophecy; justice, mercy, humility

name: Matthias
did: Chosen by lot (Acts 1:26), 'Witness with us of his resurrection'
impact: Twelfth apostle restored; chosen by God

name: Gamaliel
did: Counseled Sanhedrin to let apostles go (Acts 5:34-39), 'If it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it'
impact: Wisdom and restraint; God's work will stand

name: Philip the Evangelist
who: One of the seven deacons, evangelist
did: Preached in Samaria (Acts 8), baptized Ethiopian eunuch (Acts 8:38)
impact: Obedience to the Spirit; gospel to all

name: Joseph
who: Husband of Mary, earthly father of Jesus
did: Took Mary as wife (Matthew 1:24), fled to Egypt, raised Jesus in Nazareth
impact: Righteous man; protected and provided for the holy family

name: Simeon
did: Held infant Jesus (Luke 2:28), 'Lord, now lettest thou thy servant depart in peace'
impact: Waited for the Consolation; recognized the Messiah

name: Jairus
did: Begged Jesus to heal his daughter (Luke 8:41-42), daughter raised from dead (Luke 8:54)
impact: Faith in crisis; Jesus has power over death

name: Samaritan Woman
did: Met Jesus at Jacob's well (John 4), 'Give me this water'; brought many to believe
impact: Outcast who became evangelist; living water

name: Philemon
did: Received letter from Paul (Philemon), Paul asked him to receive Onesimus as brother
impact: Reconciliation; master and slave as equals in Christ

name: Onesimus
did: Fled from Philemon, met Paul in prison (Philemon 10), became useful; Paul sent him back
impact: Transformation; from slave to beloved brother

name: Agabus
did: Predicted famine (Acts 11:28), bound Paul's hands (Acts 21:10-11)
impact: Prophecy and warning; God's foreknowledge

name: Rhoda
did: Answered door when Peter knocked (Acts 12:13), left him at door for joy
impact: Simple faith; recognized God's answer to prayer

name: Abel
who: Second son of Adam and Eve
did: Offered acceptable sacrifice (Genesis 4:4), killed by Cain; 'his blood crieth' (Hebrews 11:4)
impact: First martyr; faith that pleases God

name: Cain
who: First son of Adam and Eve
did: Offered unacceptable sacrifice, killed Abel (Genesis 4:8), marked by God, wandered
impact: Warning against sin; God's mercy even in judgment

name: Melchizedek
who: King of Salem, priest of God Most High
did: Met Abraham, blessed him, received tithes (Genesis 14:18-20); type of Christ (Hebrews 7)
impact: Eternal priesthood; Christ like Melchizedek

name: Absalom
who: Son of David, rebelled against his father
did: Avenged Tamar, rebelled (2 Samuel 15), killed by Joab (2 Samuel 18)
impact: Pride and rebellion; consequences of sin

name: Barak
did: Led army against Sisera (Judges 4), would not go without Deborah
impact: Faith with a leader; God gave the victory

name: Shadrach
did: Refused to worship Nebuchadnezzar's image (Daniel 3), delivered from fiery furnace
impact: Faith in the fire; God with His people

name: Meshach
did: Refused to worship the image (Daniel 3), delivered from fiery furnace with Shadrach and Abednego
impact: Stand together; God delivers the faithful

name: Abednego
did: Refused to worship the image (Daniel 3), delivered from fiery furnace
impact: No compromise; fourth man in the fire

name: Nebuchadnezzar
did: Took Judah captive, saw fourth man in fire (Daniel 3), humbled; praised God (Daniel 4)
impact: God rules the nations; pride humbled

name: Cyrus
did: Decree to rebuild Jerusalem (2 Chronicles 36:22, Ezra 1), 'The LORD stirred up'
impact: God's instrument; prophecy fulfilled

name: Pontius Pilate
did: Tried Jesus (John 18-19), washed hands, delivered Him to be crucified
impact: Power and compromise; 'What is truth?'

name: Herod
who: King, ruled when Jesus was born
did: Sought to kill infant Jesus (Matthew 2), slew Bethlehem's children
impact: Earthly power vs. the King; God's protection

name: Caiaphas
did: Prophesied Jesus would die for the nation (John 11:50), led condemnation
impact: God uses even enemies; prophecy from unlikely lips

name: Simon of Cyrene
did: Compelled to carry Jesus' cross (Matthew 27:32)
impact: Shared the burden; unknown man in the story

name: Cleopas
who: Disciple on the road to Emmaus
did: Walked with Jesus unrecognized (Luke 24:13-35), 'Did not our heart burn?'
impact: Jesus reveals Himself; resurrection witness

name: Joanna
did: Wife of Chuza, Herod's steward (Luke 8:3), among those at the empty tomb (Luke 24:10)
impact: Supported the gospel; faithful to the end

name: Susanna
did: Provided for Jesus and the twelve (Luke 8:3)
impact: Women in ministry; funded the work

name: Bartimaeus
did: Cried 'Son of David, have mercy' (Mark 10:46-52), received sight; followed Jesus
impact: Persistent faith; Jesus hears the cry

name: Centurion
did: Said 'I am not worthy' (Matthew 8:8), servant healed by Jesus' word alone
impact: Great faith; Jesus marveled

name: Eunice
did: Raised Timothy in the faith (2 Timothy 1:5), 'Unfeigned faith' in him
impact: Faith passed to the next generation

name: Lois
did: Faith that dwelt in Timothy (2 Timothy 1:5), 'Unfeigned faith'
impact: Generational faith; grandmother's legacy

name: Seth
who: Third son of Adam and Eve
did: Born after Abel's death (Genesis 4:25), 'God hath appointed me another seed'; line to Noah
impact: Covenant line continued; hope after loss

name: Ishmael
did: Born to Hagar (Genesis 16), sent away with Hagar (Genesis 21), father of nations
impact: God hears; promise to Hagar; Ishmaelites

name: Hagar
did: Bore Ishmael (Genesis 16), fled; angel met her (Genesis 16:7), 'Thou God seest me'
impact: God sees the marginalized; Hagar's well

name: Goliath
did: Challenged Israel 40 days (1 Samuel 17), killed by David with a sling
impact: God versus giants; the battle is the Lord's

name: Jonathan
who: Son of Saul, friend of David
did: Covenant with David (1 Samuel 18:3), helped him escape Saul, died with his father
impact: Loyalty over family; soul knit with David

name: Eli
did: Raised Samuel (1 Samuel 3), failed to restrain his sons; ark captured; died (1 Samuel 4)
impact: Parental failure; God raises another

name: Delilah
did: Betrayed Samson's secret (Judges 16), his hair cut; he was captured
impact: Warning against compromise; cost of temptation

name: Zipporah
who: Wife of Moses, daughter of Jethro
did: Circumcised her son (Exodus 4:25), 'A bloody husband'; returned to Moses
impact: Crisis averted; covenant obedience

name: Tamar
did: Widowed twice, posed as prostitute (Genesis 38), bore Perez and Zerah; in lineage of Christ
impact: God's plan through scandal; Ruth's ancestor

name: Ahab
who: King of Israel, husband of Jezebel
did: Did evil (1 Kings 16:30), Naboth's vineyard (1 Kings 21), killed at Ramoth-gilead
impact: Compromise with evil; prophet's confrontation

name: Jezebel
who: Wife of Ahab, queen of Israel
did: Killed prophets (1 Kings 18:4), Naboth stoned (1 Kings 21), thrown from window (2 Kings 9)
impact: Evil influence; judgment on idolatry

name: Naaman
did: Healed by Elisha in Jordan (2 Kings 5), 'Now I know there is no God in all the earth but in Israel'
impact: Humble obedience; God heals the enemy

name: Jehoshaphat
did: Sought the LORD (2 Chronicles 17), allied with Ahab, 'Believe in the LORD your God' (2 Chronicles 20:20)
impact: Mixed alliances; worship before battle

name: Manasseh
who: King of Judah, son of Hezekiah
did: Did great evil (2 Kings 21), repented in captivity (2 Chronicles 33:12), restored temple
impact: Worst to repentant; God's mercy

name: Darius
did: Put Daniel in lions' den (Daniel 6), 'Thy God whom thou servest continually, he will deliver thee'
impact: Decree and deliverance; God honored

name: Joel
did: Prophesied day of the LORD (Joel 2), 'I will pour out my spirit' (Joel 2:28); Pentecost fulfilled
impact: Plague and promise; Spirit poured out

name: Obadiah
did: Prophesied against Edom (Obadiah 1), 'As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee'
impact: Judgment on pride; God's justice

name: Nahum
did: Prophesied Nineveh's fall (Nahum 1-3), 'The LORD is slow to anger' (Nahum 1:3)
impact: God's vengeance; comfort for the oppressed

name: Habakkuk
did: Why do the wicked prosper? (Habakkuk 1), 'The just shall live by faith' (Habakkuk 2:4)
impact: Honest questions; faith in suffering

name: Zephaniah
did: Prophesied day of the LORD (Zephaniah 1), 'Seek ye the LORD' (Zephaniah 2:3)
impact: Judgment and hope; remnant restored

name: Woman with Issue of Blood
did: Touched His garment (Matthew 9:20-22), 'Daughter, be of good comfort; thy faith hath made thee whole'
impact: Faith in desperation; Jesus felt power go out

name: Peter's Mother-in-Law
did: Sick with fever (Matthew 8:14-15), Jesus touched her hand; she arose and served
impact: Healing leads to service; immediate response

name: Penitent Thief
did: Rebuked other thief (Luke 23:40-41), 'Lord, remember me'; 'Today with me in paradise'
impact: Last-minute faith; grace to the dying

name: Barabbas
did: Chosen by crowd over Jesus (Matthew 27:21), Jesus took his place
impact: Substitution; He died that we might go free

name: Annas
who: Former high priest, father-in-law of Caiaphas
did: First to question Jesus (John 18:13), sent Him to Caiaphas
impact: Power behind the throne; Jesus before the council

name: Salome
did: Asked seats for her sons (Matthew 20:20-21), at the cross (Mark 15:40)
impact: Ambition and presence; mother at the end

name: Mary of Clopas
did: Stood with Mary and others (John 19:25), witnessed the crucifixion
impact: Faithful to the end; witness of the cross

name: Syrophoenician Woman
did: Begged for daughter's healing (Matthew 15:22), 'Even the dogs eat the crumbs'; daughter healed
impact: Great faith; persistence rewarded

name: Rich Young Ruler
who: Young man who asked about eternal life
did: Kept commandments (Matthew 19:20), went away sorrowful; had great possessions
impact: What holds us back; Jesus loved him
